sections.title: Use of Proceeds
sections.excerpt: Use of proceeds We intend to use the net proceeds from this offering for the purchase of insurance coverage for the Company’s directors and officers and for working capital purposes, including for the Phase II manufacturing facility, production and R&D equipment, its Xiamen headquarters and R&D platform, new product R&D (including industrial robots), talent recruitment, and working capital, with deployment expected over the next one to two years. See “Use of Proceeds” on page S-27 of this prospectus supplement. sections.excerpt:

your ownership interest will be immediately diluted to the extent of the difference between the offering price per Class A Ordinary Share

offering price per Class A Ordinary Share and accompanying Ordinary Warrant is substantially in excess of the book value per ordinary
